text: The initiative aims to integrate anticipatory action (AA) into Nepal's national disaster risk management system, transitioning from reactive to proactive disaster management. It involves the development of the National Anticipatory Action Framework and Roadmap (2026–2030), which institutionalizes forecast-informed, pre-emptive measures across government levels, financing, and delivery systems. The initiative builds on previous AA pilots, particularly the 2021 flood AA pilot, and seeks to establish a coherent, nationally owned system.

metadata.solution_name: Integration of Anticipatory Action into Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Management (DRM) System
